records.text: Terryl Farnsworth's father-in-law, Tom Burt, served as executive vice president and COO of Duncan Aviation for 22 years before retiring in 2019.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It's Tom Burt, who ran Duncan Aviation. The FBO, I told you, that rented the cars for the feds, he actually ran Duncan Aviation as the executive vice president and COO for 22 years. Now, he did retire. He retired in 2019.

verification.notes: Duncan Aviation's official retirement release says Burt spent 40 years at the company and 15 years leading its Battle Creek facility. The 22-year figure refers to successor Andy Richards, not Burt's COO tenure.

sources.title: Tom Burt, Executive Vice President & COO of Duncan Aviation in Battle Creek, Michigan, to Retire after 40 Years
sources.relevance: Duncan Aviation’s release says Burt had a 40-year company career and led Battle Creek from 2004; the 22-year tenure described his successor Andy Richards.
